component.name: Soul Player
component.summary: Play your music library with gapless, bit-perfect output

description.p: Soul Player is a native desktop music player for local and remote libraries, with a GPU-rendered interface and an all-Rust audio engine — no web view, no browser runtime.

ul.li: Gapless playback across every format the engine decodes, including FLAC, ALAC, WavPack, AIFF, MP1/MP2/MP3, Vorbis, Opus and DSD
Bit-perfect exclusive output: the sound card opened directly, bypassing the system mixer and its resampling, with per-track native-rate switching
A watched-folder library that rescans in the background, sortable and searchable, persisted across launches
Remote libraries over the network, with the catalogue cached for offline browsing
Parametric EQ, a DSP chain and ReplayGain loudness normalisation with per-track and per-album metrics
Desktop integration: media keys and the system media controls over MPRIS, cover art on the lock screen, and a system tray icon

description.p: Exclusive (bit-perfect) output needs direct access to the sound card. If you remove that permission, playback still works through the shared system mixer.

screenshot.caption: Audio settings, including bit-perfect exclusive output

Skip the per-block output-config clone in the steady state
Bound the cover-decode caches so a long browse can't run out of memory
Stop cloning the DSP chain on every audio block
Memoize home/album/artist detail pages + loudness-aware fingerprint
Tell the user when a track can't play (unsupported-format banner)
Full uninstall from Settings → About (and --uninstall), checked by the release e2e before rollback
One universal DMG for every Mac; the Intel build on Apple silicon switches itself over
Download progress with speed and time left; retry a dropped download soon
Exclusive-mode pre-warm + Windows SMTC cover art (second-look follow-ups)
Resolve_locators streams the catalog (lean, O(locators) memory)
Memoize the list page's cover resolution
Name every package soul-player, not soul-player-rune
Virtualize the detail page + stream-resolve via core no_std
Memoize the Tracks search filter by (library fingerprint, query)
Make views_by cheap at scale (memoize decodes + intern as Arc<str>)
Offer to move the app into Applications when it runs from elsewhere
Add to Playlist a whole album/artist from the card menu

Install a ready update when the app is quit with ⌘Q on macOS
Virtualize the genre detail track list
Kill the remaining per-frame O(n)/O(n^2) hotspots
Virtualize the playlists grid too
Memoize grouping + virtualize the album/artist/genre grids
Cap the context band to a bounded row count (+N more)
Reverse the sidebar queue so it drains down into now playing
Filter chips fade+collapse (reuse reveal) + arch test
Right-click menu on album + artist grid cards
Real release notes, readable errors, and no false crash prompt from a second instance
Tell package-managed installs where their updates come from
Settings → Updates page, scheduled checks, opt-in install-on-quit (0.4.1)

Unified browse-page top bar + playlists as an albums-style grid

description.p: First release with full Linux support: bit-perfect exclusive output over ALSA, window controls and desktop identity on Wayland, MPRIS media controls with cover art, and a scan report naming any files the build cannot decode.
